hero.title: An unconventional free spirit in contact with her future selves

epigraph: She lives in several worlds at once, and has the rare gift of bringing them together: heaven and everyday life, the invisible and the concrete. Feet on the Earth, eyes on the stars, a warmth that welcomes you, a demand for truth that awakens. A galactic from the future, deeply human, who takes you by the hand to show you the light you already carry.

galactic.heading: A galactic from a future

Having reconnected with her multidimensional identity by consciously reintegrating her Earthly fractals at the close of this Apocalyptic cycle.
Working with her Celestial fractals across the different timelines.
